description: Get a swap quote from RAVN — same-chain or cross-chain, across 18 chains including native (non-wrapped) Bitcoin and Solana as source or destination. Free, no API key or payment required. Returns a quoteToken; pass it to ravn_execute to get a signable/broadcastable execution payload.

allowNoMinimum.description: Let venues that enforce no minimum (today Rift) race even though slippageBps is set. Their quotes carry slippage.noMinimum true and fill at the venue's own rate: slippageBps does not protect them

apiKey.description: Your RAVN API key, if you have one — raises your rate limit

confidential.description: Settle privately via NEAR Intents' Confidential Intents so the deposit and payout can't be linked on-chain. Through this MCP server only NEAR quotes it (NO_LIQUIDITY if it can't, never a public fallback): RAVN's other private venues aren't offered here — Houdini Swap needs the end user's IP, user-agent and country for its compliance rules, and Hinkal the user's country and two signatures from the paying wallet before it builds, none of which an MCP call carries — use POST /api/v1/quote and /api/v1/execute for them. ~0.3 bps extra on EVM-to-EVM, ~5-8 bps extra when Bitcoin or Solana is a leg, and it can settle slower than a public swap (Bitcoin-source: 13 min public vs 43 min confidential) — read estimatedTimeSeconds before executing

destinationAddress.description: Where output should land, if different from userAddress. Required here, at quote time, to get an executable quote from Relay (Bitcoin as the source), THORChain (Bitcoin either direction), Across (a Solana-touching route), or Eco (a cross-ecosystem route) — omit it there and you get back a priced-but-unexecutable preview instead (see ravn_quote's executable), not an error. A malformed address, one from the wrong ecosystem, or a known non-wallet address (a RAVN-listed token's mint/contract, this swap's own tokens, the native-coin sentinel, burn addresses, Solana core programs, and via an on-chain lookup a Solana token account or program — the token-account error names the owning wallet, which is the address to use) IS an error here — funds sent there are unrecoverable. Omit the field rather than passing an empty string; an empty string is treated as omitted

excludeVenues.description: Drop specific venues, e.g. a risk objection to one of them or ravn_health showing it degraded. An excluded venue is used nowhere in the route, including the steps of RAVN's multi-step routes (compose, and relay quotes that carry hops); a multi-step route that needs it isn't offered. Venues that swap for you may route through other venues of their own choosing, which this can't reach: Layerswap (a Solana token often goes through Jupiter first), Relay, Rift, Across (when it swaps before or after bridging) and Mayan (Jupiter on Solana, other DEXs such as Nordstern on EVM). Naming a venue that was never eligible for this pair is a no-op, not an error

inputAmount.description: Positive integer string, in the input token's smallest unit (no decimals)

inputChainId.description: Numeric chain id, e.g. 1=Ethereum, 8453=Base, -1=Bitcoin, -2=Solana — see ravn_chains for the full list, or ravn_health for live venue status

inputToken.description: Token contract address, or 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeeEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE for the chain's native coin

onlyVenues.description: Race only these venues, e.g. ["bebop"] for an RFQ-only race. Every other venue is left out (including ones RAVN adds later); excludeVenues still applies on top. It covers every venue RAVN routes your funds through: a multi-step route is offered only when its own venue id and every venue in its hops are listed, e.g. ["compose","jupiter","relay"] or ["relay","kyberswap"]. RAVN's stablecoin route also needs 0x_swap beside its hops: it sweeps the leftover. Venues that swap for you may route through other venues of their own choosing, which this can't reach: Layerswap (a Solana token often goes through Jupiter first), Relay, Rift, Across (when it swaps before or after bridging) and Mayan (Jupiter on Solana, other DEXs such as Nordstern on EVM). Same-chain venues only quote same-chain pairs; if none of the named venues can quote you get NO_LIQUIDITY

outputChainId.description: Numeric chain id, e.g. 1=Ethereum, 8453=Base, -1=Bitcoin, -2=Solana — see ravn_chains for the full list, or ravn_health for live venue status

outputToken.description: Token contract address, or 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeeEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE for the chain's native coin

rankingMode.description: best_output (default) picks the highest net output; fastest picks the quickest-settling quote within slippageBps

refundAddress.description: Where to refund the input asset if the swap fails. Selling native Bitcoin with userAddress set to a Bitcoin address and no refundAddress refunds to userAddress. Well-known sample addresses (e.g. bc1qxy2kgdygjrsqtzq2n0yrf2493p83kkfjhx0wlh) count as no address: supply the real refund. Otherwise it is required here, at quote time, for a Bitcoin-source Relay or THORChain quote — neither has an execute-time re-bind, so omitting it returns a priced-but-unexecutable preview and supplying it later on ravn_execute is refused. Other BTC-source venues (Garden, Chainflip, Rift, NEAR Intents) support binding this at execute time instead. Validated against the INPUT chain (refunds are paid back on the origin), with the same non-wallet-address check as destinationAddress

slippageBps.description: Max acceptable slippage in basis points. Setting it drops venues that enforce no minimum (today Rift) from the race unless allowNoMinimum is true

timeoutMs.description: The race's time limit in milliseconds, counted from its start: once it has passed and some venue has priced the swap, slower venues are left out (with none priced yet, the first price ends the wait; a quote with slippage.noMinimum counts only 2000 ms past the limit). Defaults to 6000; a positive integer, clamped to 1000–15000

userAddress.description: Address the input asset will be sent from

name: ravn_quote

alternatives.description: Every other venue that raced and produced a usable quote, best expected net output first (each carries expectedOutputAmount: a quote with slippage.noMinimum counts 0.05–1% under its outputAmount, by token type and size, the shortfall such a venue has delivered; one more than 1% above the best quote that holds a minimum is listed here but never picked as the main quote). Each has its own quoteToken to pass to ravn_execute instead, and pickable: false when RAVN would never pick it (a preview-only price while an executable one exists, or a no-minimum quote more than 1% above every quote holding a minimum), so choose among pickable ones on expectedOutputAmount; and its own expiresAt (same meaning as above; venues differ, so check it). Empty when no other venue could serve this pair, or when a route was excluded via excludeVenues

estimatedTimeIsGuess.description: True when the time is RAVN's estimate, not the venue's own figure

executable.description: False = preview-only price, priced against a placeholder destination/refund address. ravn_execute will fail with QUOTE_NOT_EXECUTABLE — request a fresh quote with destinationAddress/refundAddress supplied instead

expectedOutputAmount.description: What RAVN counts on this route delivering, in the output token's base units: output.amount, less slippage.expectedShortfallBps when the venue holds no minimum (Rift); the same as output.amount otherwise. RAVN ranks on this (less gas), so compare routes on it, not output.amount. Alternatives carry it too

expiresAt.description: Epoch ms, always a real time: call ravn_execute before this, re-quote after. Never refused for age before it; up to 10 minutes past it, execute prices the same route again and builds it only if it still meets the minimum this quote showed, else (or later) fails with QUOTE_EXPIRED (already 5 s ahead of the venue's own deadline). Two-hop routes (venue.id compose) and venues with no deadline get 60 s: compose re-prices at execute and refuses only if the minimum shown can no longer be met

gas.description: The native gas the user must hold; null on gasless venues

hops.description: RAVN routes (venue.name "RAVN": two-hop, or Relay with a DEX on arrival): the venues it runs through, in order. Sign hop 1; hop 2 is a unique deposit

inputUsd.description: USD value of the input amount, same price source as gas.usd. Null when the token can't be priced

outputUsd.description: USD value of the output amount. Compare against inputUsd for price impact

expectedShortfallBps.description: How far under its output RAVN counts on a no-minimum route delivering, in bps (5 for a $1k+ swap of listed, non-meme tokens up to 100 under $100); 0 when noMinimum is false. Already taken off expectedOutputAmount

noMinimum.description: True when the venue enforces no minimum output (Rift fills at its own rate once the deposit lands); bps is then not a protection

slippage.description: Null when the venue reports no slippage bound

title: Get a RAVN swap quote
